title: Prove sharp all-target Q8 inverse-label tariffs
body:
## Summary

```diff
- Q8 inverse-label minima: finite two-role unit-price census
- Uniform dirty-workspace tariff: targets restricted to {1,i,j,z}
+ Every Q8 diagonal target, any finite restored dirty workspace
+ Sharp nonnegative i/j-class tariff, including inverse labels
+ Same bound with rank-one nilpotent couplings
```

The new combined parity quotient gives `XY=P_i+P_j`. Full coefficient support and Sylvester then preserve the complete joint charge for k and central targets. Coordinate words attain `alpha*(s_i+s_k)+beta*(s_j+s_k)+2*t*min(alpha,beta)`.

Credits Aaron Wang/PR2318, ywz65/PR2587 and the retained mixed-Q8/support-rank lineage. PR3137's physical caller and complete invoice remain separate. No supplier, new kappa, selected-frontier change, independent human review or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2318 supplies all 64 inverse-label pair minima at two roles; PR2587 leaves k and signed noncentral classes outside its uniform theorem.
  **After:** PROOF.md gives the all-role/all-target theorem. Exact replay passes 14,500 attaining cases, 46,656 short formal words, 4,980 rank-one factors and all 64 predecessor minima. A code-disjoint faithful regular action checks 26,904 dirty columns and 112 omissions. Three behavioral groups reject actual faulty endpoint/tariff producers and source/receipt corruption.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized checks, pinned Ruff, committed-byte/source-history preflight and Git-free committed-source replay pass. Exact commands, limits and source pins are in research/q8-inverse-uniform-tariff/.

Reproduce with `python3 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-inverse-uniform-tariff`, using an owned external TMPDIR for test exports.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Adds one opt-in research package. Frozen inputs, shared tooling and the selected result are unchanged. Positive-only signed tariffs and four independently priced signed labels remain open.
